title: fix(polli-cli): refresh harness configs
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Use canonical model IDs in every harness config
- Support OpenCode JSONC configs without overwriting invalid files
- Align Pi auth config with current Pi and release CLI 0.1.13

gist.headline: Harnesses, freshly combed
gist.blurb: Polli CLI 0.1.13 tidies up its harness configs: canonical model IDs, current Pi auth, and OpenCode JSONC that keeps its hands off broken files. Configuration gardening, with fewer mysterious weeds.
gist.summary: Released polli-cli 0.1.13 with canonical model IDs across DSH, OpenClaw, Pi, and Prime harnesses, updated Pi authentication settings, and OpenCode JSONC support that avoids overwriting invalid config files.
gist.impact: CLI users get harness configurations aligned with current integrations, while existing invalid OpenCode JSONC files remain safely untouched instead of being replaced.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden mechanic tending several tiny retro terminal harnesses labeled DSH, OpenClaw, Pi, and Prime, with neat canonical model-ID tags growing from code-plants. A CRT monitor robot can hold a slightly cracked OpenCode JSONC scroll protected inside a glass case, representing the CLI preserving invalid files rather than overwriting them.
